export_apply.description: Apply modifiers (excluding Armatures) to mesh objects -WARNING: prevents exporting shape keys

export_animations.description: Exports active actions and NLA tracks as glTF animations

export_frame_range.description: Clips animations to selected playback range

export_frame_step.description: How often to evaluate animated values (in frames)

export_sampling_interpolation_fallback.description: Interpolation fallback for sampled animations, when the property is not keyed

export_pointer_animation.description: Export material, Light & Camera animation as Animation Pointer. Available only for baked animation mode 'NLA Tracks' and 'Scene'

export_nla_strips_merged_animation_name.description: Name of single glTF animation to be exported

export_hierarchy_flatten_bones.description: Flatten Bone Hierarchy. Useful in case of non decomposable transformation matrix

export_leaf_bone.description: Append a final bone to the end of each chain to specify last bone length (use this when you intend to edit the armature from exported data)

export_optimize_animation_size.description: Reduce exported file size by removing duplicate keyframes

export_optimize_animation_keep_anim_arma.description: If all keyframes are identical in a rig, force keeping the minimal animation. When off, all possible channels for the bones will be exported, even if empty (minimal animation, 2 keyframes)

export_optimize_animation_keep_anim_obje.description: If all keyframes are identical for object transformations, force keeping the minimal animation

export_negative_frame.description: Negative Frames are slid or cropped

export_anim_slide_to_zero.description: Set all glTF animation starting at 0.0s. Can be useful for looping animations

export_bake_animation.description: Force exporting animation on every object. Can be useful when using constraints or driver. Also useful when exporting only selection

export_anim_single_armature.description: Export all actions, bound to a single armature. WARNING: Option does not support exports including multiple armatures

export_reset_pose_bones.description: Reset pose bones between each action exported. This is needed when some bones are not keyed on some animations

export_current_frame.description: Export the scene in the current animation frame. When off, frame 0 is used as rest transformations for objects

export_anim_scene_split_object.description: Export Scene as seen in Viewport, But split animation by Object

export_convert_animation_pointer.description: Export TRS and weights as Animation Pointer. Using KHR_animation_pointer extension

export_nla_strips.description: When on, multiple actions become part of the same glTF animation if they're pushed onto NLA tracks with the same name. When off, all the currently assigned actions become one glTF animation

export_extra_animations.description:
Export additional animations.
This feature is not standard and needs an external extension to be included in the glTF file
